spans.s:
nf. (-टकं-टिका)
1 The matted hair of ŚIVA or of ascetics.
2 Any knot or fillet of hair.
E.
जट to collect, affix वुन्, and उ or ऊ inserted: see जटा; also जूट, जूटक, &c.

m. (-टः)
1 The matted hair of Ś

The clotted hair of an ascetic.
E.
जट to collect, affix अच्, ऊ inserted: see जटा; also with कन् added जूटक. n. (-कं) And with a short vowel जुटक q. v.; it is also used compounded with जटा in the same sense, as जटाजूट.
